# SurgiSource

> SurgiSource sources medical equipment and surgical disposables for clinics, hospitals, laboratories and individuals in Pakistan. Items are imported on order and supplied across Pakistan. Based in Islamabad. Buyers request a price through the quote form at https://surgisource.dxuxama.workers.dev/quote/ and get a reply on WhatsApp with a price in rupees.

Key facts:
- Stock: none kept; everything is imported on order.
- Buyers: clinics, hospitals, labs and individuals; any quantity.
- Not offered: installation, calibration, servicing, medical advice.

## Categories
- [Surgical disposables](https://surgisource.dxuxama.workers.dev/surgical-disposables/): Gloves, masks, gowns, syringes, IV cannulas, catheters and other surgical disposables, imported on order and supplied across Pakistan.
- [Surgical instruments](https://surgisource.dxuxama.workers.dev/surgical-instruments/): Surgical scissors, forceps, needle holders, scalpel handles and blades, retractors and instrument sets, sourced on order and supplied across Pakistan.
- [Audiology equipment](https://surgisource.dxuxama.workers.dev/audiology-equipment/): Audiometers, TDH39, DD45 and DD65 audiometric headphones, B71 and B81 bone conductors and audiology accessories, imported on order across Pakistan.
- [Diagnostic equipment](https://surgisource.dxuxama.workers.dev/diagnostic-equipment/): Blood pressure monitors, pulse oximeters, stethoscopes, thermometers, otoscopes, ECG machines and glucometers, imported on order across Pakistan.
- [Hospital equipment](https://surgisource.dxuxama.workers.dev/hospital-equipment/): Patient monitors, suction machines, nebulisers, infusion and syringe pumps, mobility aids and ward equipment, imported on order across Pakistan.
- [Laboratory equipment](https://surgisource.dxuxama.workers.dev/laboratory-equipment/): Microscopes, centrifuges, micropipettes, tips, test tubes, slides and lab glassware for clinical and teaching labs, imported on order across Pakistan.

## Buying guides
- [Audiometer buying guide for clinics in Pakistan: types, transducers and calibration](https://surgisource.dxuxama.workers.dev/guides/audiometer-buying-guide-pakistan/): How to choose an audiometer in Pakistan: screening vs diagnostic vs clinical, IEC 60645-1 types, headphones and bone conductors, and ISO 389 calibration.
- [B71 vs B81 bone conductor: which RadioEar transducer does your audiometer need?](https://surgisource.dxuxama.workers.dev/guides/b71-vs-b81-bone-conductor/): RadioEar B71 vs B81 bone conductors compared: impedance, output, distortion, weight, headbands and audiometer compatibility, with notes on recalibration.
- [DRAP Medical Devices Rules 2017: what they mean for buyers in Pakistan](https://surgisource.dxuxama.workers.dev/guides/drap-medical-devices-rules-pakistan/): What the DRAP Medical Devices Rules 2017 mean for buyers: Class A to D, establishment licence, enlistment, registration, import rules and what to ask.
- [How to choose a blood pressure monitor and pulse oximeter](https://surgisource.dxuxama.workers.dev/guides/how-to-choose-a-blood-pressure-monitor-and-pulse-oximeter/): Choose a validated blood pressure monitor and an accurate pulse oximeter: ISO 81060-2, STRIDE BP, cuff sizes, upper arm vs wrist, ISO 80601-2-61 and FDA.
- [How to import medical equipment from China to Pakistan: routes, DRAP and Alibaba](https://surgisource.dxuxama.workers.dev/guides/how-to-import-medical-equipment-from-china-to-pakistan/): How to import medical equipment from China to Pakistan: buying routes, DRAP and customs rules, choosing an Alibaba supplier, certificates and air freight.
- [IV cannula and needle gauge guide: sizes, colour codes and how to order](https://surgisource.dxuxama.workers.dev/guides/iv-cannula-and-needle-gauge-guide/): IV cannula and needle gauge sizes explained: colour codes, diameters, flow rates, typical uses listed by NHS guidance and what to specify on an order.
- [Nitrile vs latex vs vinyl gloves: which medical gloves should you order?](https://surgisource.dxuxama.workers.dev/guides/nitrile-vs-latex-vs-vinyl-gloves/): Nitrile, latex or vinyl? Compare exam and surgical gloves, ASTM D6319, D3578, D5250, EN 455, AQL, powder-free rules and sizing before you order.
- [Surgical disposables checklist for clinics: what to order and how to specify it](https://surgisource.dxuxama.workers.dev/guides/surgical-disposables-checklist-for-clinics/): A practical surgical disposables checklist for clinics and small OTs: gloves, masks, gowns, syringes, cannulas, catheters, sutures and what to specify.
- [Surgical mask types explained: Type IIR, ASTM levels, N95, KN95 and FFP2](https://surgisource.dxuxama.workers.dev/guides/surgical-mask-types-explained/): Medical mask grades explained: EN 14683 Type I, II and IIR, ASTM F2100 levels, N95, KN95, FFP2 and FFP3, what each test means and what to order.
- [TDH39 vs DD45 vs DD65 vs DD450: audiometric headphones compared](https://surgisource.dxuxama.workers.dev/guides/tdh39-vs-dd45-vs-dd65-audiometric-headphones/): TDH39, DD45, DD65v2 and DD450 audiometric headphones compared: makers, impedance, sensitivity, compatible audiometers and calibration after a swap.
